lines.sung: Haul away, haul away, haul away, my Rosie,
Way, haul away, haul away, Joe.
O you talk about your Aver girls, And round the corner Sally;
lines.es: Oh, tú hablas de tus chicas de Havre y de Sally, la de la vuelta de la esquina;

lines.sung: Way, haul away, haul away, Joe.
But they cannot come to tea, With the girls in Booble Alley.
lines.es: Pero no pueden compararse con las chicas de Booble Alley.

lines.sung: Way, haul away, haul away, Joe.
O! once I had a nice young girl, And she was all a posy.
lines.es: ¡Oh! Una vez tuve una muchacha joven y bonita, y era toda un ramillete de flores.

lines.sung: Way, haul away, haul away, Joe.
Haul away, haul away, haul away, my Rosie,
Way, haul away, haul away, Joe.
